title: Corpus of Texts in the Indus Script
publisher: Department of Asian and African Studies, University of Helsinki
retrieval_method: Official public portal link clicked in Chrome. HELDA page said Now downloading indus_corpus_1979.pdf; browser downloaded it into Windows Downloads, then the exact filename was copied into this research folder. No login, CAPTCHA or paid access.
failed_direct_attempts: web and urllib requests to old portal PDF returned403; downloadMedia timed out, but ordinary public-link navigation completed the browser download. Direct HELDA download-page URL returns HTML rather than the file to urllib.
license: CC BY4.0, explicitly linked by the University of Helsinki Research Portal for the final published version
modifications: PDF unchanged. PyMuPDF text extraction and local PNG renders are derivatives; OCR errors preserved.
machine_readable_status: OCR layer exists but is highly corrupt for Indus glyphs. The corpus pages print drawn signs and inscription identification/metadata codes, not numerical sign sequences. OCR glyph strings are not usable sign tokenization.
technical_scope: Primary1979 edition, before1980 additions and1982 revisions. Author sign chart codes and rank numbers are distinct; distinguish catalogue variant IDs and rank-level classes.
